scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-setup.mjs && node scripts/ensure-dist.mjs && concurrently -k -n agent,pages,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:agent" "npm:dev:pages" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:computer && npm run build -w @talorys/web && npm run build -w @talorys/agent && npm run build -w create-talorys
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w @talorys/agent && npm run typecheck -w @talorys/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/functions && npm run typecheck -w create-talorys
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test -w @talorys/agent && npm run test -w @talorys/web && npm run test -w create-talorys
